g.text: Study-abroad brand: exam prep on our own platforms,
then admissions and visa in one team.
Computer-delivered IELTS mock tests with a full test
Medical-entrance course platform for Italy, with an
B2B footwear supply: depots to district retailers,
Exam-taking systems forked from the IELTS core for two
Frosted-glass GNOME widgets: exam countdown, focus
